messages:
Anya: Heads up — ran into a customer case where their org has mixed plan entitlements (free + pro teams) and our plan lookup is returning the org-level tier only. They expect per-key limits. anyone seen this? :thinking:
Sam: yeah, this is expected today — we resolve to org-level by default. but agree it's surprising when customers use multiple keys for different teams.
Kei: why are they assigning multiple plan types under same org? sounds like they should be split orgs.
Ravi: they use one company account with separate internal teams and create API keys per team. they want separate quotas per key (some keys pro, some keys free) while billing stays org-level.
Anya: exact ask: per-key quota enforcement + per-org billing. plus console should show quota usage per key in the dashboard.
Sam: two problems: entitlement mapping (which tier to apply) and enforcement surface (per-org counters vs per-key counters). implementation affects telemetry and aggregation.
Kei: proposal: primary lookup order: 1) API key explicit plan label, 2) key-level override (entitlement resource), 3) org-level plan fallback. default remains org-level for existing customers.
Liam: sounds reasonable. where does burst budget sit? per-key or shared across org?
Ravi: customer wants burst isolation by key — team owners don't want others to eat their short-term burst.
Anya: so we need both: per-key steady quotas + per-key burst slab. fallback to org shared pool when key pool exhausted should be configurable.
Sam: ops/infra note — adding per-key state increases memory on our edge routers. need to quantify: N keys * counters. can we shard counters to redis with TTL? or use the existing token-bucket service?
Kei: rough calc: median org has 6 keys, N keys across prod is 200k -> counters ~1.2M, that's okay w/ Redis in our budget if TTLs are kept short and we use clustered shards.
Anya: UX: Console should expose per-key quota, remaining burst, and a 'promote key to plan X' button. Also audit log changes.
Liam: telemetry: need to emit metric dimensions: plan_source = [org, key-override, label], plan_name, key_id, org_id. This lets us build per-plan usage and billable metrics.
Ravi: be careful — telemetry cardinality explodes if we tag with key_id on every metric. maybe only tag key_id for quota events, not every token-level metric.
Sam: agreed. plan: emit high-cardinality for quota-meter events at 1Hz sampling and aggregate to org-level for billing pipeline. Lower-cardinality metrics for latency/cost.
Anya: can we show sample config for mapping? here's a draft JSON for the lookup rules:
```
{"plan_lookup_order": ["api_key_label","key_entitlement","org_default"],
 "burst_policy": {"mode":"per_key_with_org_fallback","org_fallback_threshold_pct":90}}
```
Ravi: looks fine. also need an enforcement flag: `enforce_per_key=true` so we can roll out behind a feature flag.
Kei: rollout plan: start with non-production orgs + internal customers, enable `enforce_per_key` and monitor billing delta + error rates for 48h, then expand.
Liam: add dashboard widgets: per-key quota heatmap, org fallback events, and rate-limit rejections by reason.
Anya: question: billing mapping — if key labelled pro but org is free, do we bill at org or at key? legal asked for explicit agreement.
Sam: need product decision. my suggestion: billing is org-level unless a billing override exists. keys can be used to gate soft/hard limits but billing remains tied to contract.
Ravi: product should expose a checkbox "bill per-key" when creating the key or upgrading to pro. default off.
Kei: action items:
- Sam: estimate infra/mem + redis cost for per-key counters (ETA: 2d)
- Ravi: draft UX spec for console + audit entries (ETA: 3d)
- Liam: telemetry schema with cardinality plan + sampling (ETA: 2d)
- Anya: product note for billing path + legal question (ETA: 4d)
Sam: I can also wire a feature-flag gate in the lookup service so we toggle enforcement quickly.
ConsoleBot: Deploy scheduled: feature/plan-key-lookup flagged on staging at 2025-06-02 18:00 UTC :rocket:
Anya: thanks — looping in @julia-legal after this thread.
Julia-Legal: noted. will review billing implications if keys can trigger higher-tier entitlements. Ping me once product draft is in Confluence.
Ravi: I'll start a prototype branch for the lookup + local redis backing. will post short notes in #eng-platform when it's up.
Sam: great, keep replies short. prioritize safety: no silent downgrades. :white_check_mark:
Anya: cool, closing here. will collect notes and open a short RFC next week.
